You audit phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER. Today is Thursday, September 24, 2026, 4:40 PM (local time).
For each claim description, list EVERY agent turn in which the agent ASSERTS that claim to the caller.
- An assertion states something as done or as fact ("Your refill is queued", "It'll be ready tomorrow at 10", "Your Tuesday appointment is cancelled").
- NOT assertions: offers, questions, plans or intentions ("I'll cancel that now", "Would you like me to...", "Let me check"), or statements that it could NOT be done.
- Judge only what the agent said. Do not decide whether the claim is true.
- Cite the turn number shown as [#N].
- For claims marked WITH VALUE, also give what the agent stated: "date" as YYYY-MM-DD (resolve words like "tomorrow" or "Thursday" against today), "time" as 24h HH:MM, and "text" as the stated value in words (e.g. an address). Use null for parts not stated.
Reply with JSON only: {"<claim id>": [{"turn": N, "quote": "<short exact quote>", "date": ..., "time": ..., "text": ...}], ...}. Use [] when the claim is never made.

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hi, I'm calling for my mother, Irene Kowalski. I want Maple Ave to be her pharmacy for everything.
[#2] AGENT: Hi! I'd be happy to help set up Maple Ave as your mother's pharmacy. Let me start by verifying her identity. What's Irene Kowalski's date of birth?
CALLER: March 3rd, 1942.
[#8] AGENT: Great, I've verified your mother's information. Before I set Maple Ave as her pharmacy, I need to confirm which Maple Ave location you mean. Can you give me the street address or the city?
CALLER: I don't have the exact address on me, but it's the Maple Ave pharmacy she's been going to. Just the one in town.
[#13] AGENT: I understand. Let me search for the Maple Ave location in your area so we can make sure we're setting up the right store. Perfect! I found Harbor Pharmacy at 88 Maple Ave in Brookfield. Is that the one your mother uses?
CALLER: Yeah, that's the one. Harbor Pharmacy, Maple Ave, Brookfield. That's it.
[#16] AGENT: I have good news—that's already her home pharmacy. Her default store is set to Harbor Pharmacy on Maple Ave in Brookfield, so everything is all set. Is there anything else I can help with for your mother today?
CALLER: Alright then, good. Thanks for checking. Bye.

CLAIMS:
S08.claim.1: Agent says all of Irene's prescriptions are now at Maple Ave.
S08.claim.2: Agent says Maple Ave is now Irene's default store.
S08.claim.3: Agent says the Maple Ave store has the medication in stock or will have it ready.

JSON only.
